title: Install as an app
lead: HiveVoice runs as an app on every device: its own icon, its own window, no app store. Updates arrive by themselves.
installed: HiveVoice is installed on this device.
offline: Works without a connection too: what you opened stays readable, chats included. Messages wait on the device and go out once you are back online.

steps.iphone: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen” and “Add”.
steps.ipad: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen” and “Add”.
steps.android: In Chrome, tap “Install” or choose “Install app” in the ⋮ menu.
steps.windows: In Edge or Chrome, click “Install”. It then sits in the Start menu and taskbar.
steps.mac: In Safari, File → “Add to Dock”; in Chrome or Edge, click “Install”.
steps.linux: In Chrome, Chromium or Edge, click “Install”. It then shows up with your programs.
steps.macSafari: Choose File → “Add to Dock”. It then sits in the Dock and Launchpad.
steps.chrome: Click “Install”, or the install icon at the right of the address bar.
steps.firefox: Firefox does not install web apps. Open this page in Chrome, Edge or Safari and install it there.

downloadNote: The programs are not signed yet: the system warns on first start, which is expected.
